claim_text: On September 17, 2025, a grand jury in the District of Minnesota returned an indictment in United States v. Moktar Hassan Aden, Mustafa Dayib Ali, Khalid Ahmed Dayib, and Abdifitah Mohamud Mohamed, No. 0:25-cr-00349 (ECF 1), charging all four defendants with Counts 1–6, wire fraud, 18 U.S.C. § 1343. Each count is an alleged interstate email: Count 1, on or about September 8, 2022, from Brilliantmindservices@gmail.com attaching MNeConnect_Client_ONBOARDING_SHEET.pdf; Count 2, on or about March 17, 2023, to that address, subject Invoice 20242 from [Company A]; Count 3, on or about April 18, 2023, to that address, TIN registration; Count 4, on or about April 25, 2023, from that address, subject Re: Code.; Count 5, on or about June 26, 2024, from Foundation First Services to that address, subject Housing Consultations.; Count 6, on or about October 17, 2024, from that address attaching Provider_EFT.pdf. These are charging allegations, not adjudicated facts.
